auth_accounts_archived_at_check.name: auth_accounts_archived_at_check
auth_accounts_archived_at_check.value:
("auth_accounts"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "auth_accounts"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("auth_accounts"."status" <> 'ARCHIVED' AND "auth_accounts"."archived_at" IS NULL)

bookings_archived_at_check.name: bookings_archived_at_check
bookings_archived_at_check.value:
("bookings"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "bookings"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("bookings"."status" <> 'ARCHIVED' AND "bookings"."archived_at" IS NULL)

driver_licenses_date_range_check.name: driver_licenses_date_range_check
driver_licenses_date_range_check.value: "driver_licenses"."issued_on" IS NULL OR "driver_licenses"."expires_on" IS NULL OR "driver_licenses"."expires_on" > "driver_licenses"."issued_on"

drivers_source_vendor_check.name: drivers_source_vendor_check
drivers_source_vendor_check.value:
("drivers"."source_type" = 'OUTSOURCED' AND "drivers"."vendor_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("drivers"."source_type" = 'AGENCY' AND "drivers"."vendor_id" IS NULL)

drivers_shift_pair_check.name: drivers_shift_pair_check
drivers_shift_pair_check.value:
("drivers"."shift_start_time" IS NULL AND "drivers"."shift_end_time" IS NULL)
          OR ("drivers"."shift_start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "drivers"."shift_end_time" IS NOT NULL
              AND "drivers"."shift_start_time" <> "drivers"."shift_end_time")

feedback_photos_state_check.name: feedback_photos_state_check
feedback_photos_state_check.value:
("feedback_photos"."status" IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND "feedback_photos"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "feedback_photos"."attached_at" IS NULL AND "feedback_photos"."feedback_submission_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("feedback_photos"."status" = 'READY' AND "feedback_photos"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "feedback_photos"."attached_at" IS NULL AND "feedback_photos"."feedback_submission_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("feedback_photos"."status" = 'ATTACHED' AND "feedback_photos"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "feedback_photos"."attached_at" IS NOT NULL AND "feedback_photos"."feedback_submission_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("feedback_photos"."status" = 'REJECTED' AND "feedback_photos"."attached_at" IS NULL AND "feedback_photos"."feedback_submission_id" IS NULL)

feedback_submissions_archive_state_check.name: feedback_submissions_archive_state_check
feedback_submissions_archive_state_check.value:
("feedback_submissions"."current_review_state" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "feedback_submissions"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("feedback_submissions"."current_review_state" <> 'ARCHIVED' AND "feedback_submissions"."archived_at" IS NULL)

questionnaires_archived_at_check.name: questionnaires_archived_at_check
questionnaires_archived_at_check.value:
("questionnaires"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "questionnaires"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("questionnaires"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "questionnaires"."archived_at" IS NULL)

version_questions_score_bounds_check.name: version_questions_score_bounds_check
version_questions_score_bounds_check.value: "version_questions"."score_min" IS NULL OR "version_questions"."score_max" IS NULL OR "version_questions"."score_min" <= "version_questions"."score_max"

trips_vendor_snapshot_check.name: trips_vendor_snapshot_check
trips_vendor_snapshot_check.value:
("trips"."driver_source_snapshot" = 'OUTSOURCED'
            AND "trips"."vendor_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "trips"."vendor_name_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("trips"."driver_source_snapshot" = 'AGENCY'
            AND "trips"."vendor_id" IS NULL
            AND "trips"."vendor_name_snapshot" IS NULL)

trips_archived_at_check.name: trips_archived_at_check
trips_archived_at_check.value:
("trips"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' AND "trips"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("trips"."status" <> 'ARCHIVED' AND "trips"."archived_at" IS NULL)
